description: Everything needed to write a look recipe without reading code: every setting with its path, label, plain meaning, group, type, range, step, unit, choices, default, visibility (shown, advanced or hidden in the app) and support (now: the phone draws it; planned: stored, not drawn yet), plus the brand color tokens with this workspace's colors, the font ids, text animation kinds, caption motions and styles, transition kinds, sound effect ids and the sticker packs. Call it once before recipe_create or recipe_update. Settings are dotted paths such as grade.look.warmth or captions.motion; colors are {token: ink|paper|accent|accent2|muted|brand_primary|brand_secondary} or {hex: "#RRGGBB"}. Numbers outside their range are clamped and reported in notes. recipe_schema gives every setting with its label, meaning, range, choices and default; a * means stored but not drawn yet.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
